verses.2:
Great is the LORD in Zion;
 He is exalted above all the peoples.
verses.3:
Let them praise Your great and awesome name —
 He is holy! + 99:3 Or it is holy!
verses.4:
The mighty King loves justice. + 99:4 Or The might of the King loves justice. 
 You have established equity;
 You have exercised justice
 and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.7:
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud;
 they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
verses.8:
O LORD our God, You answered them.
 You were a forgiving God to them,
 yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
verses.9:
Exalt the LORD our God
 and worship at His holy mountain,
 for the LORD our God is holy.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
